title: Family's in town. Get them out of the house.
why: Thanksgiving-visitor carousel for Austin locals hosting family after bat season ends; pushes the Skyline Tour.
hook_options: Four days of family. One good afternoon.
The Thanksgiving plan nobody argues about
Black Friday, minus the parking lot
caption: Family in town for Thanksgiving? The Skyline Tour runs at 10am, 1pm and 4pm. Two hours on Lady Bird Lake, guide and gear included, back in time for round two of pie. #thanksgivingaustin #ladybirdlake #austinkayaktours #thingstodoinaustin

slides.headline: Family's in town. Get them out of the house.
slides.body: Four days, one living room, the same game on TV. A skyline paddle fits between leftovers and dinner.

slides.headline: Everyone wants to do something. Nobody agrees.
slides.body: Grandparents want easy. Teens want anything but a museum. Someone needs a nap by 3.

slides.headline: Two hours on Lady Bird Lake
slides.body: The Skyline Tour runs at 10am, 1pm and 4pm. Guide, kayak, life vest, downtown from the water.

slides.headline: Tandems mean nobody paddles alone
slides.body: Rachel D. liked that you can "choose if you want a single or tandem kayak." Put the nervous uncle up front.

slides.headline: Austin history, told from the water
slides.body: West side history, architecture and landmarks. Reviewers keep bringing up the guides' stories.

slides.headline: "Great with out-of-town guests"
slides.body: Lisa E.'s words: "A great thing to do while visiting Austin or with out-of-town guests."

slides.headline: Turtles on logs, herons on the bank
slides.body: Mild fall afternoons on the lake. Turtles, ducks and herons are common, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Book the 1pm. Thank us at dinner.
slides.body: Leftovers for lunch, a paddle after, home with time to shower before the second round of pie.

slides.headline: Black Friday, minus the parking lot
slides.body: Most of the family is off the day after. Spend it outside instead of in a checkout line.

slides.kicker: Send this to the family group chat
slides.headline: One afternoon they'll actually remember
slides.body: Skyline tours on Lady Bird Lake. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
